summary: Monica is a self-hosted personal relationship-management (CRM) web app where each account owns multiple vaults, each holding contacts of the account's users, plus notes, calls, life events, loans, journal posts, reminders, labels/tags and per-account personalization (genders, templates, relationship types etc), all backed by a Laravel/MySQL model layer.
